title.narrative: Fostering low cadmium and climate-relevant innovations to enhance the resilience and inclusiveness of the growing cocoa sectors in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru (Clima LoCa)

description.narrative: The Actions objective is to foster the development, implementation and scaling of low cadmium and climate-relevant production practices and technologies that fit the diverse contexts of smallholder cocoa production (OUTCOME), thereby contributing to resilient, competitive and inclusive cocoa value chains and reducing vulnerability of smallholder cocoa producers in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru to the impacts of new food safety regulation and climate change (IMPACT).
